events.body: DL-1949: import duty and tax of £248.40 outstanding on entry IE-4755. Held at Destination depot under payment hold. Storage of £6.50 per day accrues from 3 May. The hold lifts automatically when the entry balance is nil.
My broker dealt with the duty on this. Why does tracking say awaiting payment
Import billing shows £248.40 outstanding on entry IE-4755 for DL-1949. Can you confirm whether payment has been made, and with what reference?
Paid 27 April. £212.40 by deferment account, our ref QCB-4559. That is the assessed amount on our entry copy.
The broker for DL-1949 reports a payment of £212.40 on 30 Apr by deferment account, reference QCB-4559. Please check it against entry IE-4755.

Checked the entry ledger: nothing posted to IE-4755, balance still £248.40. QCB-4559 doesn't appear on this entry. I haven't searched deferment statements or other entries; that needs a reconciliation request with the broker's statement line.
DL-1949 still on payment hold, bay H-4. Storage started today. We can't release against a hold, only Import billing lifts it.
Depot told me on the phone I can just pay the 248 by card and collect today. Should I do that? I need the inks this week.

Duty on DL-1949 was paid a week ago. I have already sent you the reference. Your carrier is now charging my client storage on goods that are cleared and paid. Release it today and cancel the storage. Statement line: 30/04 DEF QCB-4559 £212.40 PLOVER ARC IMPORT.
